messages:
maya: quick sync on PR #5012  the disconnected install guide shows /etc/hosts with IP-only entries for KMS/HSM. QA said it reads like IPs are required. should we standardize wording?
oto: prefer hostname + TLS certs. only use /etc/hosts as a documented bootstrap fallback.
fiona: agreed. also add a one-liner that cert CN/SAN must match the hostname clients use. we've seen IP-only CN break client TLS checks.
kevin: add this curl example to show safe validation when using /etc/hosts as fallback:
`curl --resolve "kms.local:443:10.1.2.3" --cacert /etc/kms/ca.pem https://kms.local/health`
maya: good. can we also remind folks that some HSMs expose management on a separate NIC and to allow that in firewall rules?
oto: yes, a short HSM note: PKCS11 lib path varies by vendor; show a generic snippet and link vendor docs for slot discovery.
fiona: small docs fix: a couple of anchors changed in the cert chapter; i updated the PR to fix links.
docs-ci: docs build succeeded for PR #5012 (:white_check_mark:)
maya: thanks team. i'll update the disconnected guide to: hostname-first examples, /etc/hosts as bootstrap, the curl validate snippet, HSM PKCS11 stub, and a troubleshooting hairpin/NAT bullet. merging after review.
